707.2: Endless adornment of the home, delights in the mind, the relish of tastes:
those creatures who (amid these) never remember (the Lord), O Nanak, are worms in filth. ॥1॥
707.3: Great pomp, everything there is, and fondness and attachment (for it) within:
O Nanak, the one who forgets that Master, that body is dust. ॥2॥
707.4: A beautiful bed, countless comforts, pleasures and enjoyments in full;
houses of gold, scented with sandalwood, set with pearls and diamonds;
he enjoys the pleasures the mind desires, and has no worry at all;
(yet if) that God does not come to mind, (such people are) worms in filth.
Without the Lord's Name there is no peace; by what means can the mind be comforted? ॥6॥
707.5: In longing for the lotus feet (of the Lord), the one who has turned from the world searches in all ten directions;
he renounces deceitful Maya, O Nanak, (and finds) the Saadh Sangat, the very form of bliss. ॥1॥
707.6: With the Master in my mind, I utter (his Name) with my mouth and roam all the worlds;
says Nanak: all show is false; I live by hearing (his) true praise. ॥2॥
707.7: (One) lives in a broken-down hut, his clothes all in rags;
he has no caste, no honour, no respect, and wanders in the wilderness;
he has no friend or loved one, no wealth, no beauty, and no relation or kin at all;
(yet) he is the king of the whole world, his mind soaked in the Lord's Name.
By the dust of his (feet) the mind is saved, and God is well pleased. ॥7॥
707.8: Countless sports, the joys of kingship, beauty, the royal canopy and fly-whisk, and a seat upon the throne:
the fools, blind with ignorance, are absorbed in these; O Nanak, the longings of Maya are a dream. ॥1॥
707.9: In a dream (one) enjoyed every pleasure, and attachment felt sweet;
O Nanak, without the Name, beautiful Maya is a deception. ॥2॥
707.10: The fool has fixed his mind on a dream;
(on waking) the kingdom, the pleasures and the enjoyments are forgotten, and awake, he is left babbling.
His years have gone by as he chased after worldly business;
his tasks were never completed; Maya has enticed him.
What can the poor creature do, when (the Lord) himself has led him astray? ॥8॥
707.11: They may live in the realms of heaven and win the earth with its nine regions,
(yet) if they forget the Lord, Gopal, O Nanak, those mortals roam a wilderness. ॥1॥
707.12: Amid millions of wonders and spectacles, (if) the Name does not come to his mind,
O Nanak, that very place is equal to millions of hells, a wasteland. ॥2॥
707.13: They have taken a most terrible wilderness for a city;
seeing false things, they have taken them for true;
in lust, anger and ego they roam about crazed.
When Jam's club struck the head, then they repented.
Without the perfect divine Guru, a person wanders about like Satan. ॥9॥
708.1: Kingship is deceit, beauty is deceit, wealth is deceit, and so is pride of lineage;
(people) amass poisonous Maya by fraud and wrongdoing, but, O Nanak, apart from the Lord, none (of these) go along (with anyone). ॥1॥
708.2: How I erred in looking: the colocynth (tumma) seemed beautiful to me;
it does not fetch even half a cowrie; O Nanak, Maya does not go along with (anyone). ॥2॥
708.3: Why gather what does not go along when one departs?
Say, why strive for that from which one must be parted?
Forgetting the Lord, how can one be satisfied? The mind is not gladdened.
Whoever leaves God and clings to another is sunk in hell.
Be kind and merciful (O God), and let Nanak's fear be destroyed. ॥10॥
708.4: Not sweet are the comforts of kingship, not sweet the relish of enjoyments, not sweet the comforts of Maya;
sweet is the Lord in the Saadh Sangat; to servant Nanak, sweet is the sight of God. ॥1॥
708.5: That love has taken hold by which the mind is dyed from within;
(the mind) is pierced by the True Thing (the Name); O Nanak, that Master seems sweet. ॥2॥
708.6: Without the Lord nothing seems sweet to the devotees.
All other tastes are insipid: they have tested this and seen.
Ignorance, doubt and sorrow have been cut away, for the Guru has become (their) intercessor.
(Their) mind is pierced through by the lotus feet (of the Lord), like the (fast) colour of madder.
God is (their) soul, breath of life, body and mind; all falsehood has perished. ॥11॥
708.7: Parted from water the fish does not live; nor does the chatrik, if it leaves the realm of the clouds;
the deer, (drawn) by the sound, is pierced by the arrow; the bumblebee is bound, (drawn) by the flower's fragrance;
(just so) the Sants are absorbed in the lotus feet (of the Lord); O Nanak, nothing else pleases them. ॥1॥
708.8: If I see (your) face for the blink of an eye, I would not leave (you) to give my heart to another.
O Nanak, (true) life is union with that Master, the Lord, the friend of the Sants. ॥2॥
708.9: As a fish without water: how can it stay alive?
The chatrik, deprived of the raindrop: how can it be satisfied?
The deer, pierced by the (hunter's) music, rises and runs towards it;
the bumblebee, greedy for the scent of the flower, meets it and has itself caught.
So do the Sants love the Lord; beholding the sight of him, they are filled. ॥12॥
708.10: Those who dwell on (the Lord's) lotus feet and worship (him) with every breath,
who never forget the Name of the Imperishable: O Nanak, the Supreme God fulfils their hopes. ॥1॥
708.11: (The Lord) is stitched into (their) minds, and is not apart (from them) for an instant;
O Nanak, that True Master fulfils (their) hope and ever watches over (them). ॥2॥
708.12: O Lord of the world, fulfil the hope of (me,) the one who hopes;
O Gopal, O Gobind, meeting (you), one never grieves.
Grant (me) the sight of you, there is a longing in (my) mind, so that (my) sorrows lift.
May (my) body become pure with the dust of (your) feet.
O Supreme Lord, O divine Guru, (may I) remain ever in your presence. ॥13॥
709.1: Those whose tongues utter the Name, whose ears hear the Amrit Shabad,
and whose attention is on the Supreme Lord: Nanak is ever a sacrifice to them. ॥1॥
709.2: Without the one Master, all deeds are false.
O Nanak, they alone are blessed who love the True One. ॥2॥
709.3: I am ever a sacrifice to those who hear the Lord's praises told.
Perfect and foremost are those who bow their heads before God.
Beautiful are those hands that write the praise of the boundless Lord.
Holy and pure are the feet that walk on God's path.
In the company of the Sants one is saved, and all suffering has gone. ॥14॥
709.4: When, by perfect good fortune, the destiny (written on the forehead) comes to light, the Lord is remembered,
and the sight of Gopal is attained: O Nanak, fruitful is that moment. ॥1॥
709.5: I cannot put a price on (those) joys; they are beyond all measure.
O Nanak, approved is that blessed hour in which my Beloved meets (me). ॥2॥
709.6: Tell (me), which is that time in which I may find God?
Auspicious is that moment, that hour of union, in which the Lord of the world is met.
Meditating on the Lord at all hours, may I fulfil the longing of (my) mind;
by great good fortune may the Sat Sangat come about, and may I bow low and fall at (their) feet.
In (my) mind is a thirst for the sight of (God); Nanak is a sacrifice (to him). ॥15॥
709.7: Gobind makes the fallen pure and removes every fault.
O Nanak, the Lord is a mighty champion to those in his refuge who repeat Har, Har, Har. ॥1॥
709.8: The one who has given up all self-conceit and clings close to (God's) feet:
his pain and fever have fled, O Nanak, as he beholds God. ॥2॥
709.9: Unite (me with you), O Merciful one; I have fallen at your door.
Save (me), O you who are merciful to the meek; wandering, I have grown utterly weary.
To love devotion is your age-old way, O Lord, and to save the fallen.
Apart from you there is no one to take up my plea.
O Merciful one, take hold of (my) hand (and draw me out of) the world-ocean. ॥16॥
709.10: The Merciful one saves the Sants, whose support is the Kirtan of Gopal.
In the company of (such) Sants one becomes pure; O Nanak, (their) shelter is the Supreme God. ॥1॥
709.11: Neither sandalwood nor the moon nor the cool season can take away the (mind's) burning heat at all;
O Nanak, one becomes cool (only) by repeating the Name of the Lord. ॥2॥
709.12: In the shelter of (the Lord's) lotus feet all (his) people have been saved.
Hearing of Govind's glory, (their) minds have become fearless.
It never runs short at all: (they) have gathered the wealth of the Naam.
The company of the Sants is found through great merit.
Meditate on the Lord at all hours, and listen to the Lord's praise every day. ॥17॥
709.13: (The Lord) shows mercy and takes away the pain (of the one who) utters the Name and the praise
of the merciful Lord, the all-pervading Being: O Nanak, Maya does not stain (that one). ॥1॥
710.1: The blazing fire has been put out; God himself is the protector.
O Nanak, repeat (the Name of) that God who created the earth. ॥2॥
710.2: Once God has become merciful, Maya does not take hold.
Tens of millions of sins were destroyed by meditating on the one Lord.
Bodies became pure, bathed in the dust of (his) servants' feet.
Mind and body grew content on finding the perfect God.
(Their) families have crossed over, and with them (their) people and all (their) line. ॥18॥
710.3: The Guru is Gobind, the Guru is Gopal; the Guru is Narayan, pervading all.
The Guru is merciful, the Guru is mighty; O Nanak, the Guru lifts up the fallen. ॥1॥
710.4: The world-ocean is terrible and unfathomable; the Guru, the ship, has carried me across.
O Nanak, perfect fortune lies in clinging to the True Guru's feet. ॥2॥
710.5: Blessed, blessed is the divine Guru, in whose company (the Name of) the Lord is repeated.
When the Guru became merciful, all failings were hidden away.
The Supreme Lord, the divine Guru, has raised the lowly to high places.
Cutting the noose of Maya's pains, he has made (them) his own servants.
With the tongue (they) have sung the virtues and the praise of the boundless Lord. ॥19॥
710.6: Only the One is seen, only the One is heard; only the One, the Lord (Narhar), is at work (in all).
(We) beg for the gift of the Name; says Nanak, O merciful Being, show (us your) grace. ॥1॥
710.7: I serve the One, I keep the One in mind; my prayer is to the one Lord alone.
(I) have gathered the merchandise and the wealth of the Name; O Nanak, this is the true capital. ॥2॥
710.8: God is merciful and boundless; this One alone pervades all.
He himself is everything; whom could I name as a second?
O God, you yourself give the gift, and you yourself receive it.
All coming and going is your Hukam (your will and command); your own abode stands unshakeable.
Nanak begs for this gift: in your grace, give (me) the Naam. ॥20॥
710.9: Raag Jaitsri, the hymns of the Bhagats.
Ik Oankar: God is One, the all-pervading Creator, realised through the True Guru's grace.
I have sold (my) mind into the hands of Maya.
You are called the Guru of the world, the Master;
I am called a lustful one of Kalyug.
These five have so corrupted my mind
that moment by moment they set a distance (between me and) the dear Lord.
Wherever I look, there is a heap of pain;
even now (my mind) is not convinced, though the Vedas bear witness.
Gautam's wife (Ahalya), and the lord Shiva, husband of Uma,
who bore (Brahma's severed) head, and (Indra,) who came to bear a thousand marks of the female organ: (all were brought low by these five).
These demons have beaten the fool (of a mind) mercilessly,
(yet it is) utterly shameless; even now it has not grown weary (of them).
Says Ravidas: where can one go, what can one do?
Without Raghunath (the Lord), whose refuge can one seek? ॥6॥
